name: Seed-Prover
one_liner: A Lean prover that writes whole proofs from lemmas and revises them using Lean feedback, proven lemmas and summaries of earlier tries.

loop.proposes: Lean proofs built from lemmas, from a language model
loop.steers: Lean feedback, proved lemmas and self-summaries of earlier attempts go into the next try, with three test-time strategies

headline_result: The abstract reports 78.1% of formalized past IMO problems proved, MiniF2F saturated, above 50% on PutnamBench, and 5 of 6 IMO 2025 problems fully proved; a separate Seed-Geometry engine handles geometry.
caveat: This card rests on the abstract only. Budgets, training details and who formalized the IMO 2025 statements are not stated there.
beyond_harness_note: Lean decides validity and the finished proof is checkable without the model; the abstract does not support weight updates from the loop.

sources.title: Seed-Prover: Deep and Broad Reasoning for Automated Theorem Proving

verification.notes: Abstract only (arXiv 2507.23726, v2). Org 'ByteDance Seed' is from the system's naming; the abstract fetch did not list affiliations, so confirm before publishing. Compute and formalization conditions not checked. Org: PDF lists ByteDance Seed AI4Math per search result; the PDF text itself did not decode in review, so the full author list is unconfirmed.
